During my senior year of college all of my friends started calling me Michaelsoft. Even the pretty girls we'd hang out with would call me Michaelsoft. Trust me, they didn't call me that because it sounded cool. They all knew I just came back from my internship in Redmond and would be headed back full time after graduation. Thank god people forgot that nickname. 

This summer I crossed the 10 year mark at the company. My entire career, in one place. Over the past decade I had to learn a lot of lessons the hard way. Here are a few thoughts as I look back on my career so far.
